findings.claim: 美國 2025 年取消 US$800 de minimis 免稅額：中國／香港 2025-05-02 起，全部包裹 2025-08-29 起；所有進口件皆須課關稅並補報關資料，可能降低跨境量。
findings.excerpt: The exemption was first eliminated for shipments originating in China and Hong Kong on May 2, 2025, and then for all parcels effective August 29, 2025. As a result, all imports, regardless of value, are now subject to applicable duties, taxes, fees and standard customs compliance procedures.

findings.claim: 跨境貿易是營收與利潤的重要來源，且為大中華區等市場的主要（或唯一）業務；貿易政策變動可對買賣家造成重大影響。
findings.excerpt: Cross-border trade is an important source of both revenue and profits for us. Cross-border trade also represents our primary (or in some cases, only) presence in certain important markets, such as Greater China, and various other countries.

findings.claim: 歐盟宣布 2026 年 7 月取消 €150 de minimis 並徵每件 €3 費用，英國預期跟進；2025 年關稅變動已改變消費者支出。
findings.excerpt: the E.U. has announced it will remove its €150 “de minimis” exemption in July 2026 and require a €3 fee per parcel, and the U.K. is expected to follow with eliminating its £135 “de minimis threshold” for low-value imports.

findings.claim: eBay 風險因素提及制裁與出口管制合規風險：客戶可能以虛報、轉運等方式規避，公司對客戶行為控制有限。
findings.excerpt: We have limited control over our customers’ conduct, and some may attempt to circumvent sanctions or export controls through misrepresentation, transshipment, use of intermediaries, or false product descriptions, increasing compliance and enforcement risk.

reg_tariff_export.note: eBay 為平台，無自有製造供應鏈；暴露在買賣家跨境流量。2026 年美國對中關稅稅率搜尋來源互相矛盾，未採用。

clues.claim: Jefferies 曾因中國跨境貿易潛在逆風調降 eBay 評等（2025 年報導）
